name: Rule N
placementTarget: Rulebook, rule N, the Build Shelter action.
summary: Build Shelter. Discard a card of your current city's color to build a shelter there. If no shelter figure is left, move an existing shelter to your city instead. Characters in a sheltered city, or leaving one, cannot be exposed. A sheltered city does not lose population at game end, and does not lose population when a 4th Hollow Men figure would be placed there. No P3 code is printed on the sticker. The rule letter N is the manual's name for this action.

mechanics.timing: As an action on your turn, once this sticker is in the rulebook.
mechanics.effect: Discard one City card matching the color of your current city and place a shelter in that city. If all 6 shelter figures are already on the board, move one shelter from another city to your city instead. Characters in a city with a shelter, and characters leaving such a city, cannot get exposed. At game end, a city with a shelter does not lose population. It also does not lose population when a 4th Hollow Men figure would be placed in it.
restrictions: The discarded card must match the color of the city you are in, unless Hong Kong's Structural Engineer is in your hand and you are taking this action.
The move-a-shelter line applies when no figure is left in the Shelters bag.
Exposure protection covers being in the city and leaving it.
The player-aid sticker (sticker-06) is a shorter reminder and does not repeat the move, the leaving clause, or the population lines.
